elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of at least USD 5,000,000 unconditionally, which satisfies the requirement whenever HDI processes Customer Data.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: HDI must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: HDI must provide the Company with certificates evidencing the required coverage on request.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required professional liability (errors and omissions) limit is USD 2,000,000, exceeding the USD 1,000,000 fallback.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required cyber and privacy liability limit is USD 5,000,000, exceeding the USD 2,000,000 fallback.
